The same authenticated official kernels_output session API was then called with an explicit UTF-8 text writer and returned the immutable complete log.

transport_diagnosis.inference: Because the unarchived transport audit from the same dataset was found and passed while the .zip container alone was absent, Kaggle dataset ingestion/mount normalization most likely expanded the ZIP contents rather than preserving the container filename. This is a transport-format inference, not a scientific result.
transport_diagnosis.independent_file_listing: The authenticated ListDatasetFiles endpoint still returned 403, so no independent remote file-list claim is made.

bounded_correction: Preserve the exact archive bytes under a non-archive mount filename, verify the same SHA-256 at runtime, and extract those bytes with the unchanged safe extractor. Do not change scientific source, protocol, cache, baseline checkpoint, split or fit settings.
